text: You have an idea. Your agent has a thousand defaults.
Before it builds another one, give it a direction.
Foreman starts with the person you are building for.
Find the references. Choose what belongs. Leave the rest.
Turn those decisions into a brief you can actually approve.
Then build. With the choices already made.
Check the details that turn a draft into a website.
Your idea. Built with intention. Meet Foreman.
